children: Shares of Barry Diller's People Inc. rose after The Wall Street Journal reported that MGM Resorts International is discussing making a bid to acquire the company in a surprising role reversal.

People's stock jumped 13% to $40.59 in after-hours trading Thursday following the Journal's report. Shares closed roughly flat at $35.93 and have fallen 8.1% this year. Shares in MGM were roughly flat.
The Journal reported that MGM could make the offer in the coming days if it decides to proceed, according to people familiar with the matter.
The deal could give MGM an avenue to repurchase People's roughly 27% stake in its business while acquiring other assets at an attractive price, according to the Journal's report.
The development comes just one day after Diller withdrew his offer to acquire all of the remaining equity in MGM in a $12.4 billion deal, according to a Journal report on Wednesday.
